description: This file contains extension methods for registering grain services within the Orleans framework, specifically for integrating grain services into the silo builder and service collection.

classes.name: GrainServicesSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for registering grain services with the Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddGrainService
methods.description: Registers a grain service implementation type T to be started with the silo, extending ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: GrainServiceFactory
methods.description: Creates an instance of a grain service given its type and the service provider, ensuring it implements IGrainService.

methods.name: AddGrainService
methods.description: Adds a grain service type T to the service collection, returning the updated collection.

methods.name: AddGrainService
methods.description: Adds a grain service of specified type to the service collection as a singleton IGrainService.
